resources.string: Free up space in one tap
We look for screenshots, duplicate photos and useless images in your gallery. You decide what goes.
Everything happens on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
We need permission to see your photos and videos. Enable it in Settings › Apps › Cleaner › Permissions and try again.
This can take a moment if you have many photos.
